title: Secreted dual reporter assay with Gaussia luciferase and mCherry
author: Diana Wider
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kbwcspe

steps.title: Prepare samples for measurement
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µl of supernatant into a 96-well dish (black flat bottom, non-binding surface polystyrene; e.g., Corning catalog number 3991).

steps.title: Measure mCherry fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure the mCherry fluorescence using a fluorometer according to the instrument settings guidelines.

steps.title: Measure Gluc bioluminescence
steps.instruction: Trigger the Gluc bioluminescence reaction by adding 50 µl Gluc buffer per well.

substeps.instruction: Work rapidly as luminescence declines to approximately 80% by 6 minutes
Use a multichannel pipet or injector if processing a large number of wells

steps.title: Dilute samples if necessary
steps.instruction: If a more diluted sample is required, dilute supernatants separately.

substeps.instruction: Use Opti-MEM complemented with 10% FBS for Gluc dilution
